faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Jhajjar PTS-III recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting applications for the AIIMS Jhajjar PTS-III (Project Technical Support-III) recruitment is 31 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this AIIMS Jhajjar recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment drive is PTS-III (Project Technical Support-III).

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the PTS-III post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the PTS-III (Project Technical Support-III) post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this job is via email. Candidates need to send their applications to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for the PTS-III post?
faq.answer: The educational qualification required is MBBS / BDS + Post Graduate Degree (MDS/MPH/PhD) with three years of post-qualification research experience, or a Master's Degree in a relevant discipline with three years of experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for the PTS-III post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the PTS-III post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the AIIMS Jhajjar PTS-III recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for a Contractual job position.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the AIIMS Jhajjar located for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The AIIMS Jhajjar location for this recruitment is Jhajjar, Haryana, with a pincode of 124105.
